item.name: Aquila 44 "Catastic" - Coronado Captain Charter
item.sold_out_text: Sold Out- Call for Other Options
item.description:
#The ultimate small group sailing experience! 														

## About
The Aquila 44 is a pure bred power catamaran with a fresh evolution of classic boating traditions. Efficiency in design and performance compliment her luxurious living. She features 3 cabins, 3 heads, spacious salon and galley and extensive flybridge.
A US Coast Guard captain’s license is required for this vessel.

Rates include all taxes, fees and fuel charges. The listed rate does not include the cost for a USCG Licensed captain to drive the boat for you. Per federal law we cannot select a captain for you, but would be happy to introduce you to a choice of local skippers who are qualified operate the boat. The hired captain will be paid directly at the time of the rental.

## More info


###Cancellation policy: 

Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund. Once you are within 72 hours, no changes or cancellations are permitted. Failure to show for reservation still incurs full rental rate and is not eligible for a refund or reschedule. As the renter, you are responsible for checking the weather forecast and making any desired changes at least 72 hours in advance.			

## What to bring
Photo ID and credit card used for payment required for check in. Captain's fee is $100/hour + gratuity, paid directly to captain in cash

**Rules and regulations for rental boats**
The following is a list of rules and regulations that does not include all rules, restrictions that may apply to the use and rental of this vessel. Instructions will be given verbally as well as in writing. ***Make sure you understand and ask questions before you go.***
- Vessels must be returned prior to closing time
- No one under 18 years old may operate the vessel
- You may not operate the vessel if you are under the influence of alcohol or drugs
- You must obey speed limits including idle speed rules in basins and marinas
- You must obey right of way rules and restrictions imposed by gov’t agencies or u.S. Navy rules
- You may not use the vessel for towing
- In the event of unsafe conditions (weather, sea condition or vessel traffic), you shall proceed to a safe area and seek assistance.
- The renter is responsible for the safety and conduct of his / her passengers and shall operate the vessel with this in mind at all times
- You shall not approach any dock or pier until you and your crew are ready to safely secure the boat. You shall make sure all occupants are seated and they keep hands and feet in the boat while docking
- Bow riding and teak surfing are strictly prohibited
- You must obey all state, local, and federal rules regarding operation of boats
- You shall not tie up to other boats while underway. You may not pick up additional passengers after departure
- You may be subjected to fines and additional fees if you violate the above rules

***THIS IS A BAREBOAT CHARTER***
Your bareboat charter agreement has been emailed to you. Please be sure you can access this if requested by safety and security officers on the water.
